description: What the Registry serves, for the OGC share templates of the Hub (FR-XC-31, FR-SHR-01, FR-SHR-04). 'wmtsCapabilities' is the Contents of the WMTS GetCapabilities of a dataset with the built rasters 'ortho.tif', a nested one 'odm_orthophoto/odm_orthophoto.tif' (AC-015) and one whose name is not an NCName, 'my map (1).tif': the Layer Title is the entry path, the Identifier its NCName, and the ResourceURL templates name the layer by its escaped path (encodeURIComponent plus the characters !'()* that Uri.EscapeDataString also escapes), as asserted by Registry.Web.UnitTest/Ogc/OgcContractFixtureTests; 'restfulExtensions' is WmtsConformance.ExtensionFormats (the RESTful route accepts pbf, png, jpg, jpeg); 'servicesByEntryType' lists the entry types each service serves: WmsManager (GeoRaster only, WmsManager.cs:53,262,438), WmtsManager (rasters in GetCapabilities; vector tiles through the RESTful route as pbf), WcsCoverageService (GeoRaster only), WfsFeatureQuery and OgcApiFeaturesManager (Vector only), OgcApiTilesManager (both). This file is copied to Registry.Web.UnitTest/Ogc/Fixtures/ogc-contract.json: when the Registry changes, change both copies and the Hub in the same step.
